canonical_title: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
abstract: Coordinates capture reconstruction, physical modeling and simulator inspection to create editable simulation environments from 3D and 4D captures.
screening_reason: Agents inspect intermediate simulator outputs and revise geometry or transforms, providing an explicit graphics authoring feedback loop.

screening_evidence.evidence: An orchestrator plans conversion; agents run tools and use actor-critic visual inspection to repair poses and assets. Geometric thresholds check alignment. Inputs include images, videos and 3D captures; output contains meshes, transforms, physical properties and joints.

contribution: Coordinates capture reconstruction, physical modeling and simulator inspection to create editable simulation environments from 3D and 4D captures.
limitations: Physical parameters are approximate; selected method passages were inspected, not a complete replication.

canonical_title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
abstract: Evaluates agents that write executable programs to produce complete videos with sound, using 239 tasks and requirement-based evaluation.
screening_reason: A benchmark directly evaluating agent-authored graphics and audiovisual artifacts.

screening_evidence.evidence: Tasks provide language specifications and optional assets. Agents deliver a video, editable source and timing sheet. Separate program checks and judge panels evaluate delivered artifacts.

contribution: Evaluates agents that write executable programs to produce complete videos with sound, using 239 tasks and requirement-based evaluation.
limitations: Benchmark judges are held-out evaluation; they are not assumed to provide feedback during agent execution.

canonical_title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
abstract: Uses a streaming video-language model to choose broadcast cameras and generate synchronized esports commentary.
screening_reason: Camera selection affects a visual broadcast, but its fit to the survey graphics-authoring scope needs review.

screening_evidence.evidence: The model observes player cameras, selects hold-or-switch camera actions and comments on the selected view.

contribution: Uses a streaming video-language model to choose broadcast cameras and generate synchronized esports commentary.
limitations: Abstract-only screening; no full method review or confirmed artifact-revision loop.

canonical_title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
abstract: Benchmarks long-video reasoning with persistent memory and retrieval tools.
screening_reason: The inspected abstract evaluates video understanding and question answering, not graphics artifact creation or editing.

screening_evidence.evidence: LongVideo and 4DMemoryBench evaluate visual, textual and spatiotemporal questions; the harness adds skills, tool models and retrieval.

contribution: Benchmarks long-video reasoning with persistent memory and retrieval tools.
